verdict.rationale: Pigment documents several programmatic surfaces: 'open APIs' for integration, an Audit Trail API, and an official MCP server for building and editing models from Claude, Cursor or Codex. That covers part of what the UI does, but nothing claims or demonstrates full UI parity, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: documented API-UI parity statement, published API reference/OpenAPI spec, evidence of API coverage for reporting, scenarios, permissions and workflow features, independent corroboration.
